facts.fact: A crime management system built by a UNMISS police officer was handed over to the South Sudan National Police ICT directorate in Juba on 5 December 2025, recording incidents and reports, with a commitment to bring it into official nationwide operation still to be met.

systems.country_label: Hệ thống quản lý tội phạm (Crime Management System) 2025
systems.owner: South Sudan National Police Service ICT directorate
